title: Vercel-owned Convex Preview lifecycle and tenant bootstrap

target.candidate_state: uncommitted working tree independently reviewed before publication

north_star: Make Vercel the durable owner of isolated Convex Preview deployments and secret provisioning without changing Production or accepting deployment-local tenant IDs at the public intake boundary.

evidence.marketplace_resource: pass — Vercel-owned Convex resource skys-the-limit-platform-convex is available and connected to sky-s-the-limit-platform for Preview only
evidence.preview_defaults: pass — names-only inspection confirms LEAD_INTAKE_SECRET, WORKOS_API_KEY, WORKOS_CLIENT_ID, WORKOS_ORGANIZATION_ID, and WORKOS_WEBHOOK_SECRET as managed Convex Preview defaults; no values were printed or committed
evidence.deploy_key_dry_run: pass — Vercel Preview environment injection plus npx convex deploy --dry-run selected the Marketplace preview key and would claim/deploy the requested branch backend
evidence.tenant_isolation: pass — signed intake uses stable WORKOS_ORGANIZATION_ID and an internal indexed Convex query resolves the active deployment-local organization before persistence
evidence.preview_bootstrap: pass — internal-only idempotent mutation creates or reuses the branch organization and fails closed on inactive or conflicting state
evidence.production_boundary: pass — vercel.json runs Convex deploy only for VERCEL_ENV=preview; all other environments retain npm run build and Production remains unconnected/unmodified
evidence.workflow_boundary: pass — secrets are not placed in Vercel Workflow state; Marketplace configuration and Convex Preview defaults own the control-plane lifecycle
evidence.focused_tests: pass — 5 focused files / 42 tests passed for proof signing, unknown-tenant rejection, idempotency, rate limiting, CI bootstrap, environment contract, and Vercel build policy
evidence.static_checks: pass — lint, tsc --noEmit, verify:skills, verify:env, verify:assets, and git diff --check passed
evidence.dependency_audit: pass — npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities
evidence.generated_env: pass — generated Env declarations were aligned with the installed Convex 1.43 codegen template; hosted Preview deploy/codegen is the publication reproducibility gate
evidence.independent_review: pass after remediation — evaluator confirmed Production remains Next-only, tenant resolution is deployment-safe, NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL is build-frozen from the managed Convex deploy command, and the change may advance to hosted Preview verification

residual_risk: The first hosted dev deployment must prove that /api/estimate persists into the new Vercel-managed Convex Preview before stale Preview URL and organization-ID variables are removed.
Sensitive Vercel variables are intentionally scoped to dev, so feature-branch Vercel builds fail closed; the authoritative hosted build occurs after reviewed code lands on dev.
Production Convex migration remains a separate owner-approved change.
